  {"step": 1, "file": "glog/src/fuzz_demangle.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 27, "var": "Buffer", "code": "char Buffer[Size + 1]; std::memcpy(Buffer, Data, Size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input Data of Size bytes is copied into a dynamic stack (VLA) buffer of Size+1 bytes; the only valid readable range is Buffer[0..Size]."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "glog/src/fuzz_demangle.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 28, "var": "Buffer", "code": "Buffer[Size] = 0;", "note": "The VLA buffer is null-terminated at index Size."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "glog/src/fuzz_demangle.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 30, "var": "Buffer", "code": "google::Demangle(Buffer, demangled, Size);", "note": "The attacker-controlled Buffer is passed as the mangled name to the demangler."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "Demangle", "line": 1359, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "InitState(&state, mangled, out, out_size);", "note": "state.mangled_cur is set to point at the start of the small VLA Buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseTopLevelMangledName", "line": 1305, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "if (ParseMangledName(state))", "note": "ParseMangledName matches the '_Z' prefix and advances mangled_cur."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseEncoding", "line": 492, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "if (ParseName(state) && ParseBareFunctionType(state))", "note": "ParseEncoding invokes ParseName, which routes to ParseLocalName matching the 'Z' local-name marker."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseLocalName", "line": 1243, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "if (ParseOneCharToken(state, 'Z') && ParseEncoding(state) && ...)", "note": "ParseLocalName recursively invokes ParseEncoding on the inner encoding; this inner ParseEncoding reaches ParseUnqualifiedName."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseUnqualifiedName", "line": 604, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "(ParseSourceName(state) && Optional(ParseAbiTags(state)))", "note": "ParseUnqualifiedName calls ParseSourceName on the remaining input."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseSourceName", "line": 609, "var": "length", "code": "if (ParseNumber(state, &length) && ParseIdentifier(state, length))", "note": "ParseNumber parses the 10-digit string '2222222222'; the 32-bit int overflows and wraps to the negative value -2072745074, stored in length."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseIdentifier", "line": 694, "var": "length", "code": "if (length == -1 || !AtLeastNumCharsRemaining(state->mangled_cur, length))", "note": "With negative length -2072745074 (not -1), AtLeastNumCharsRemaining's loop does not execute and returns true, so the negative length is accepted."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseIdentifier", "line": 703, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "state->mangled_cur += length;", "note": "mangled_cur is advanced by the negative length -2072745074, moving it ~2GB before the start of the VLA Buffer (out of bounds)."},
  {"step": 12, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseUnqualifiedName", "line": 604, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "Optional(ParseAbiTags(state))", "note": "ParseSourceName returned true, so ParseUnqualifiedName calls ParseAbiTags on the now out-of-bounds mangled_cur."},
  {"step": 13, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseAbiTag", "line": 722, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "return ParseOneCharToken(state, 'B') && ParseSourceName(state);", "note": "ParseAbiTag calls ParseOneCharToken which reads mangled_cur[0] from the out-of-bounds pointer, causing the invalid READ crash."},
  {"step": 14, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseOneCharToken", "line": 211, "var": "state->mangled_cur[0]", "code": "if (state->mangled_cur[0] == one_char_token)", "note": "Reading mangled_cur[0] from the pointer moved ~2GB before the VLA Buffer triggers the memory-safety violation (READ)."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON, steps:', len(d))"
